android.desc:
Financial Architect is a simple app for personal money management.

Free version:
- Keeping balances of your bank accounts, cards and wallets (unlimited accounts).
- Tracking the incomes and expenses.
- Budgeting.
- Customization of categories for expenses and incomes (unlimited).
- Multiple currencies (unlimited).
- Charts for cash flow, incomes and expenses.
- Filters by accounts, categories, currencies and comments.
- Export data to CSV table.
- Saving data to archive for transfer.

PRO-version with paid subscription:
- Reading operations from SMS and Push notifications.
- Tracking loans.
- Synchronization with partners.
- Backup data on server.
- No Ads.

If you have any questions or concerns about the Financial Architect please email us at support@financial-architect.ru.
